extraction_notes: Main-text catalytic-performance figures with directly plottable selectivity/STY were Figure 5a,b. Figure 6 was skipped because it is explicitly an Arrhenius plot. Figure 7 kinetic dependence plots report ln(rate) versus ln(partial pressure); they are kinetic rate-order plots rather than selectivity/conversion/STY plots and the provided schema has no dedicated CO formation-rate field, so they were not digitised here. Figures 8–10 are DRIFTS/TPD characterisation, not catalytic performance. In Figure 5b the green CO STY bars were read and recorded in notes because the response schema has no separate CO STY field.
